answer: What survives to the horizon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the tundra until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ridge of the next round. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
